posts.author: pumpkanne
posts.body:
Hello everyone!!
I'm Pumpkanne, but you can also call me Anne. I've been dabbling in RPG Maker since 2017 (just checked Steam to be sure
). I started with VX Ace, and I am currently trying to learn MZ. I'm a
BIG
fan of the horror games made in this engine. I recently replayed a bunch of the classics and thus got inspired to, once again, attempt my own.
I guess that's it for my introduction. I hope you all have an amazing day!!
